identity.site: Portland — 4410 NW Front Ave, Portland, Oregon 97210

scan.summary: This is the company's own training and evaluation roster for forklift and powered pallet jack operators at the Portland facility (page 1). A signed training certificate for one operator, Michael Chen, is on page 2. It lists three operators with their training and evaluation dates. One of them, R. Patel, was due for a three-year re-evaluation on 2026-05-19, and nothing shows it was done. The record itself has not been updated since June 2, 2025.
scan.freshness_note: The roster was last updated June 2, 2025, about 16 months ago. Since then R. Patel's re-evaluation date (2026-05-19) has passed and no new entry was made. Ask the Warehouse Supervisor for a current roster that shows whether Patel was re-evaluated, whether she has stopped operating FL-2, and whether any operators have been added or have left.

gaps.title: R. Patel three-year evaluation overdue
gaps.description: The roster shows R. Patel's most recent evaluation as 2023-05-19 and her next evaluation due 2026-05-19. As of 2026-09-30 that date is more than four months past, and the record shows no re-evaluation. If she is still operating FL-2, she is doing so without a current evaluation.
gaps.fix: Take R. Patel off FL-2 until Sandra Ortiz (or another qualified evaluator) evaluates her in the workplace and gives refresher training if needed. Then update the roster, file a signed certificate, and set her next due date three years out.
gaps.citation: 29 CFR 1910.178(l)(4)(iii) (an evaluation of each operator's performance at least once every three years), adopted in Oregon under Oregon OSHA Division 2, Subdivision N
gaps.locator: Page 1, operator table, R. Patel row

gaps.title: No certificate on file noted for R. Patel
gaps.description: The Notes column says "certificate on file" for Chen and Rivera but is blank for Patel. The table itself has the name, dates and trainer, but you cannot tell whether a signed certificate exists for her.
gaps.fix: Find Patel's 2023 certificate, or issue a new one when her re-evaluation is done, and mark the Notes column.
gaps.citation: 29 CFR 1910.178(l)(6) (certification that each operator has been trained and evaluated)
gaps.locator: Page 1, operator table, R. Patel row, Notes column

gaps.title: Record not updated since June 2025
gaps.description: The record has not been touched since June 2, 2025, even though an evaluation came due in May 2026. It also says no refresher training was required "in 2025 or 2026 to date", but you cannot tell when that statement was written.
gaps.fix: Review the roster at least whenever a due date passes or staff change. Add a new 'last updated' date and confirm the refresher statement is still true.
gaps.quote: Record maintained by: Warehouse Supervisor · Last updated: June 2, 2025

gaps.title: Rivera certificate not in this file
gaps.description: The roster says a certificate is on file for J. Rivera, but only Michael Chen's certificate is attached (page 2).
gaps.fix: Add Jose Rivera's signed certificate (evaluation 2025-06-02) to this file so the whole set is in one place.

I am certain the Patel due date of 2026-05-19 has passed as of 2026-09-30, and the document shows no re-evaluation. It may have happened and not been recorded; I cannot tell which. The three-year evaluation and certification requirements are in 29 CFR 1910.178(l)(4)(iii) and (l)(6). I believe Oregon OSHA adopts 1910.178 by reference in Division 2, Subdivision N (the rule number I recall is OAR 437-002-0227), but I did not check the current Oregon rule text. The Rivera-certificate gap is inferred from what is missing from this file, not from anything wrong in the roster. I have not judged whether the trainer's qualifications meet the standard's knowledge-and-experience test.
